app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

hours.description:
Hours is genuinely conditional per-location -- confirmed both absent
(embedded state JSON "operatingHours":null on some profiles) and
present as a full 7-day table on others. An empty list here is a
real result, not a parser failure.

status.description:
Status is one of BBB's fixed complaint-status values: Resolved,
Unresolved, Answered, Unanswered, Unpursuable. Passed through as
rendered rather than validated, since it is an upstream-controlled
response value, not a request parameter.

complaints_list_incomplete.description:
ComplaintsListIncomplete is true when TotalComplaints is non-zero
but BBB's itemized complaint list came back empty anyway. Confirmed
live on at least one high-volume multi-location business (770 total
complaints, page rendered "There are no matching results. Improve
your results by removing some applied search filters." with no
filters actually applied by this client) -- an upstream filter/
pagination quirk, not a parser failure. TotalComplaints/
ClosedLast12Months remain authoritative; Complaints will be empty
even though real records exist upstream.

rating_reasons.description:
RatingReasons is the full per-factor reasons list from /more-info,
not the shallow single-bullet list bbb-business returns.

service_areas.description:
ServiceAreas is the full list of counties/cities/regions this
business serves, confirmed untruncated live. Genuinely
business-conditional -- confirmed absent entirely on at least one
business (no #service-area section rendered at all), so an empty
list here is a real possible result, not a parser failure.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.

get.description: Returns a normalized bbb.org business profile: BBB rating letter grade and reasons, accreditation status and since-date, years in business, BBB file/incorporation dates, entity type, contact info, business categories, social media, and a short latest-reviews preview. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data.

get.description: Returns a business's BBB complaint history: total complaint count, complaints closed in the last 12 months, and per-complaint detail (date, type, status, narrative text, and any business response / customer answer thread). A business with no filed complaints returns total_complaints 0 and an empty complaints list -- this is a normal result, not an error. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data.

parameters.description: BBB business profile URL, from a bbb-search result's url or hq_profile_url
parameters.name: url

get.summary: Get a Better Business Bureau business's complaint history

get.description: Returns a business's full per-factor "Reasons for Rating" list and full service-area list, from the separate BBB business profile /more-info sub-page. The bbb-business endpoint's own rating_reasons field is read from the main profile page and typically holds only one generic boilerplate bullet regardless of actual rating; this endpoint fetches the richer, business-specific list instead. Service area is business-conditional -- some businesses render no service-area section at all, in which case service_areas is empty. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data.

parameters.description: BBB business profile URL, from a bbb-search result's url or hq_profile_url
parameters.name: url

get.summary: Get a Better Business Bureau business's full rating reasons and service area

get.description: Returns a business's full customer-review list (author, star rating, date, text, and any business response thread), paginated 10 per page, plus the average star rating and total review count. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data. Unlike the other bbb-business-* endpoints, this one is fetched with browser impersonation rather than plain direct HTTP -- see the family's maintenance note for why.

parameters.name: page

get.description: Searches bbb.org Scam Tracker's consumer-reported-scam database by free-text query, scam category, targeted-victim state/province, reported-scammer state/province, report-date range, and/or dollar-loss range, paginated 10 results/page. Omit every filter to browse the most-recent-first feed. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data. This is a separate BBB dataset from the bbb-search/bbb-business/bbb-business-complaints business-rating family -- consumer-reported scam incidents, not business ratings.

get.description: Returns the live sort, category, and state/province values BBB currently advertises for one context. Supply query and location for text search, or category_url for the exact category-browse context; do not combine these modes. Category IDs and state/province codes are query-scoped; call this endpoint again when the search context changes. Static accepted values are country USA or CAN; sort Relevance, Distance, Rating, AToZ, or ZToA; distance 5, 10, 25, 50, or 100 miles; rating A, B, C, D, or F. Credential-free public Better Business Bureau data.
